assumptions: Geometry and 166 m approximate height inferred from a single perspective image; hidden depth is assumed.
3D pin-jointed equivalent lattice: core chords and diagonals approximate tower bending/shear; triangulated box loops approximate ring bending/torsion.
Small displacement elasticity; tension-only cable active set, without pretension or geometric stiffness.
Loads are illustrative fixed tributary nodal forces, not code-derived; thickness changes area by scale squared and does not recalculate gravity.
Floor plates, glazing, guardrails and circulation are visual geometry, not shell elements.
No foundations/soil, dynamics, buckling, connection design, nonlinear concrete or capacity/compliance checks.
